evidence.title: Bíblia Raízes | Estude a Bíblia em Hebraico e Grego

name: Bíblia Raízes
summary: Portuguese Bible study platform with Hebrew and Greek word-by-word text, cited AI answers and a library of classic works.
description: Bíblia Raízes maps the Almeida Revista e Atualizada text to biblical Hebrew and Greek word by word, showing transliteration, morphology, meaning in context and every occurrence. An AI assistant answers in Portuguese with cited sources drawn from the Scriptures and the library of 11 classic works; highlights, per-verse notes, a study editor and a prayer list round it out.
contains: Hebrew and Greek word-by-word mapping with transliteration, morphology and occurrences
interlinear view; Almeida Revista e Atualizada translation
AI answers in Portuguese with cited sources (included in the launch offer)
library of 11 classic works in Portuguese
highlights, per-verse notes, study editor and prayer list
works in the browser and installs as an app
launch offer: R$ 97.90 one-time lifetime access (12x R$ 9.77); 7-day refund; later annual subscription
